code:
library(ROvis.plotly) bar_data <- tibble::tibble( Sex = c("Man", "Vrouw"), n = c(1234, 1675) ) # Use the color function for Rijksoverheid / RIVM colors sex_colors <- c( "Man" = ro_color("hemelblauw"), "Vrouw" = ro_color("robijnrood") ) # Create plotly bar chart fig <- plot_ly( data = bar_data, x = ~Sex, y = ~n, type = "bar", color = ~Sex, colors = sex_colors, text = ~paste0( "Geslacht: ", Sex, "", "
Aantal cases: ", format(round(n, 0), big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE), "" ), hoverinfo = "text" ) # Apply Rijksoverheid / RIVM theme fig <- ro_ply_add_theme(fig, ro_ply_theme())
